name: Katashiro
source:
Clearworld Narahama's very own humanoid support unit.

While they may seem to be heavily-equipped people, their innards are mechanical, and they even come installed with the latest type of AI.

They are deployed in schools, companies, dormitories, and other public institutions, where they send information on the health and activities of Clearworld residents to the central organization to best ascertain any trouble or health concerns.
A number of units are delegated to patrolling or cleaning.
